assignment: deterministic counterbalanced table (assignment-table.json); operator uses seed/executor shown in UI
banner: OPERATOR DESIGN REVIEW — NOT A USER STUDY
flow: 8 trials: presentation = focus on first answer control; submit or 180 s timeout
pause/resume allowed; withdraw keeps remaining trials as missing
mode: owner/reviewer walkthrough of one operator as design conformance review

forbidden_in_git: raw browser event logs of the operator
privacy.ids: opaque session/participant ids without identity mapping

rules: operator judgment never becomes a participant score
accessibility accommodations disclosed, results never excluded
